_comment: Dune: Awakening — Pelican egg. Runs a full Linux Docker dedicated-server battlegroup using SteamCMD anonymous downloads + CubeCoders' MIT-licensed launch scripts (mock Kubernetes API, patchelf'd Funcom OCI binaries). Requires a custom runtime Docker image built from this repo's docker/Dockerfile.
name: Dune: Awakening
author: valentin95150@hotmail.fr
description: Dune: Awakening dedicated server (full battlegroup with always-warm Survival_1, Overmap, and DeepDesert_1 plus on-demand instances). Native Linux Docker via Funcom's official OCI tarballs (Steam app 4754530 retail / 3104830 PTC), extracted and patchelf'd at install time. Orchestration ports CubeCoders' AMP module (MIT) to the Wings runtime model. Requires a custom runtime image (see docker/Dockerfile) that pre-creates /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ with container-user ownership.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Dune: Awakening Pelican install script
#
# Runs in the install container (ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian) with
# root and writes to /mnt/server (mounted as /home/container at runtime).
# The runtime image (see docker/Dockerfile in this repo) must be built and
# pushed to a registry the Wings host can pull from before this egg works.
#
# Steps:
#   1. apt install build-time deps
#   2. Download SteamCMD
#   3. SteamCMD anonymous download of Funcom depot
#        - 4754530 = Production (retail)
#        - 3104830 = PTC (public test)
#   4. Fetch the CubeCoders launch scripts tarball from AMPTemplates upstream
#   5. Symlink depot -> server and run scripts/install.sh to patchelf binaries
#   6. Write the Pelican entrypoint wrapper

set -euo pipefail

SRCDS_APPID="${SRCDS_APPID:-4754530}"
STEAM_USER="${STEAM_USER:-anonymous}"
STEAM_PASS="${STEAM_PASS:-}"
STEAM_AUTH="${STEAM_AUTH:-}"

case "$SRCDS_APPID" in
    4754530|3104830) ;;
    *)
        echo "ERROR: SRCDS_APPID must be 4754530 (retail) or 3104830 (PTC); got '$SRCDS_APPID'" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

echo "==> Installing build-time dependencies..."
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
dpkg --add-architecture i386
apt-get update -q
apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates curl tar gzip jq file lib32gcc-s1 libcurl4:i386 patchelf iproute2 gawk python3

mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/server

echo "==> Downloading SteamCMD..."
curl -fsSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz \
    | tar -xz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd

echo "==> Downloading Funcom Dune: Awakening server depot (app $SRCDS_APPID)..."
echo "    Depot is ~5 GB compressed; extracts to ~12 GB. Anonymous-accessible."
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd
export HOME=/mnt/server
./steamcmd.sh \
    +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType linux \
    +force_install_dir /mnt/server/server \
    +login "$STEAM_USER" "$STEAM_PASS" "$STEAM_AUTH" \
    +app_update "$SRCDS_APPID" validate \
    +quit

if [ ! -d /mnt/server/server/images ]; then
    echo "ERROR: SteamCMD download finished but /mnt/server/server/images/ is missing." >&2
    echo "       Check the SteamCMD log above for errors (login failure, app not owned, etc.)." >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "==> Fetching CubeCoders launch scripts from AMPTemplates @ main..."
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CubeCoders/AMPTemplates/main/duneawakeningupdates.json \
    | jq -r '.[0].UpdateSourceData' \
    | base64 -d \
    | tar -xz -C /mnt/server/
chmod +x /mnt/server/scripts/*.sh /mnt/server/scripts/mock-k8s-go

# Phase-1/2 panel-variable applier. Lives next to upstream CubeCoders
# scripts; pelican-entrypoint.sh invokes it after prestart seeds the
# Funcom-stock INIs. Kept in sync with scripts/apply-config.sh in the
# git repo — the heredoc IS the canonical source at install time.
cat > /mnt/server/scripts/apply-config.sh <<'APPLY_CONFIG_SH_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Apply Pelican panel variables to Funcom's UE5 ini files.
#
# Mirrors the surface CubeCoders' AMP template exposes through its
# metaconfig automap. We support three target sinks:
#
#   - UserEngine.ini  → [ConsoleVariables] section (UE5 cvars)
#   - UserGame.ini    → [/Script/...] sections   (UE5 property classes)
#   - ondemand.ini    → flat key=value             (mock-k8s pool tuning)
#
# Behaviour:
#   - Empty/unset env var ⇒ skip the row entirely (operator hand-edits survive).
#   - Section missing      ⇒ append a fresh `[section]` and the key/value.
#   - Key present          ⇒ rewrite in place under the matching section.
#   - Key missing          ⇒ append the key at the end of the section.
#
# Called from pelican-entrypoint.sh AFTER prestart.sh has seeded the
# Funcom-stock templates.

set -euo pipefail

BASE="${1:-${DUNE_BASE_DIR:-/home/container}}"
export DUNE_APPLY_BASE="$BASE"

exec python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import os
import re
import sys
import traceback

BASE = os.environ["DUNE_APPLY_BASE"]
USERENGINE = f"{BASE}/server/state/ue5-saved/UserSettings/UserEngine.ini"
USERGAME = f"{BASE}/server/state/ue5-saved/UserSettings/UserGame.ini"
ONDEMAND = f"{BASE}/server/state/ondemand.ini"

# (env_var, target_file, section_or_None, ini_key, quote_string_value)
# section=None ⇒ flat KVP (ondemand.ini style).
APPLY_MAP = [
    # --- World identity (was hand-rolled in entrypoint before this script) ---
    ("DUNE_SERVER_PASSWORD",             USERENGINE, "ConsoleVariables", "Bgd.ServerLoginPassword",                            True),
    ("DUNE_SERVER_DISPLAY_NAME",         USERENGINE, "ConsoleVariables", "Bgd.ServerDisplayName",                              True),

    # --- Resource yield (loot) ---
    ("DUNE_MINING_OUTPUT",               USERENGINE, "ConsoleVariables", "Dune.GlobalMiningOutputMultiplier",                  False),
    ("DUNE_VEHICLE_MINING_OUTPUT",       USERENGINE, "ConsoleVariables", "Dune.GlobalVehicleMiningOutputMultiplier",           False),
    ("DUNE_PVP_ZONE_RESOURCE_MULT",      USERENGINE, "ConsoleVariables", "SecurityZones.PvpResourceMultiplier",                False),

    # --- Vehicle behaviour ---
    ("DUNE_VEHICLE_DURABILITY_DAMAGE",   USERENGINE, "ConsoleVariables", "dw.VehicleDurabilityDamageMultiplier",               False),
    ("DUNE_SANDWORM_INVULN_ON_EXIT",     USERENGINE, "ConsoleVariables", "Vehicle.SandwormInvulnerabilitySecondsOnExit",       False),
    ("DUNE_SANDWORM_INVULN_ON_RESTART",  USERENGINE, "ConsoleVariables", "Vehicle.SandwormInvulnerabilitySecondsOnServerRestart", False),
    ("DUNE_SANDWORM_VEHICLE_COLLISION",  USERENGINE, "ConsoleVariables", "Vehicle.SandwormCollisionInteraction",               False),

    # --- World conditions / weather ---
    ("DUNE_SANDSTORMS_ENABLED",          USERENGINE, "ConsoleVariables", "Sandstorm.Enabled",                                  False),
    ("DUNE_SANDSTORM_TREASURE",          USERENGINE, "ConsoleVariables", "Sandstorm.Treasure.Enabled",                         False),
    ("DUNE_SANDWORMS_ENABLED",           USERENGINE, "ConsoleVariables", "sandworm.dune.Enabled",                              False),
    ("DUNE_SANDWORM_DANGER_ZONES",       USERENGINE, "ConsoleVariables", "Sandworm.SandwormDangerZonesEnabled",                False),

    # --- PvP / safety toggles (UserGame.ini UClass properties) ---
    ("DUNE_FORCE_PVP_EVERYWHERE",        USERGAME,   "/Script/DuneSandbox.PvpPveSettings",       "m_bShouldForceEnablePvpOnAllPartitions", False),
    ("DUNE_SECURITY_ZONES_ENABLED",      USERGAME,   "/Script/DuneSandbox.SecurityZonesSubsystem", "m_bAreSecurityZonesEnabled",          False),
    ("DUNE_CORIOLIS_AUTO_SPAWN",         USERGAME,   "/Script/DuneSandbox.SandStormConfig",      "m_bCoriolisAutoSpawnEnabled",            False),

    # --- Decay & building limits ---
    ("DUNE_ITEM_DETERIORATION_RATE",     USERGAME,   "/DeteriorationSystem.ItemDeteriorationConstants", "UpdateRateInSeconds",             False),
    ("DUNE_MAX_LANDCLAIM_SEGMENTS",      USERGAME,   "/Script/DuneSandbox.BuildingSettings",     "m_MaxNumLandclaimSegments",              False),
    ("DUNE_BLUEPRINT_MAX_EXTENSIONS",    USERGAME,   "/Script/DuneSandbox.BuildingSettings",     "m_BuildingBlueprintMaxExtensions",       False),
    ("DUNE_BASE_BACKUP_MAX_EXTENSIONS",  USERGAME,   "/Script/DuneSandbox.BuildingSettings",     "m_BaseBackupMaxExtensions",              False),
    ("DUNE_BUILDING_RESTRICTION_LIMITS", USERGAME,   "/Script/DuneSandbox.BuildingSettings",     "m_bBuildingRestrictionLimitsEnabled",    False),

    # --- On-demand server pool (mock-k8s consumes ondemand.ini, flat KVP) ---
    ("DUNE_MAX_CONCURRENT_INSTANCES",    ONDEMAND,   None,                                       "MaxConcurrentInstances",                 False),
    ("DUNE_AUTO_STOP_DURATION",          ONDEMAND,   None,                                       "AutomaticStopDuration",                  False),
    ("DUNE_ALWAYS_WARM_MAPS",            ONDEMAND,   None,                                       "AlwaysWarmMaps",                         False),
]


def log(msg):
    print(f"[apply-config] {msg}", flush=True)


def apply_keyed(path, section, key, value, quoted):
    """Update or insert key=value under [section] in an INI file.
    Returns True if the file was (re)written, False on skip/reject."""
    if not os.path.isfile(path):
        log(f"WARN target {path} missing — [{section}] {key} skipped")
        return False

    if quoted:
        if '"' in value:
            log(f"WARN value for {key} contains a double quote — UE5 won't parse this. Skipped.")
            return False
        rendered = f'"{value}"'
    else:
        rendered = value

    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
        lines = f.read().splitlines(True)

    section_re = re.compile(rf"^\s*\[{re.escape(section)}\]\s*$", re.IGNORECASE)
    any_section_re = re.compile(r"^\s*\[[^\]]+\]\s*$")
    key_re = re.compile(rf"^[;\s]*{re.escape(key)}\s*=", re.IGNORECASE)

    out = []
    in_target = False
    section_seen = False
    key_done = False

    for line in lines:
        if section_re.match(line):
            section_seen = True
            in_target = True
            out.append(line)
            continue
        if any_section_re.match(line):
            if in_target and not key_done:
                # Section ran out of lines — inject before the next header.
                if out and out[-1].strip() == "":
                    out.insert(len(out) - 1, f"{key}={rendered}\n")
                else:
                    out.append(f"{key}={rendered}\n")
                key_done = True
            in_target = False
            out.append(line)
            continue
        if in_target and not key_done and key_re.match(line):
            out.append(f"{key}={rendered}\n")
            key_done = True
            continue
        out.append(line)

    if not section_seen:
        if out and not out[-1].endswith("\n"):
            out.append("\n")
        out.append(f"\n[{section}]\n{key}={rendered}\n")
    elif not key_done:
        if out and not out[-1].endswith("\n"):
            out.append("\n")
        out.append(f"{key}={rendered}\n")

    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.writelines(out)
    log(f"  {os.path.basename(path)} [{section}] {key}={rendered}")
    return True


def apply_kvp(path, key, value):
    """Update or insert key=value in a flat key=value file (no sections).
    Returns True if the file was (re)written, False on skip."""
    if not os.path.isfile(path):
        log(f"WARN target {path} missing — {key} skipped")
        return False

    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
        lines = f.read().splitlines(True)

    key_re = re.compile(rf"^[;\s]*{re.escape(key)}\s*=", re.IGNORECASE)
    replaced = False
    out = []
    for line in lines:
        if not replaced and key_re.match(line):
            out.append(f"{key}={value}\n")
            replaced = True
        else:
            out.append(line)
    if not replaced:
        if out and not out[-1].endswith("\n"):
            out.append("\n")
        out.append(f"{key}={value}\n")

    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.writelines(out)
    log(f"  {os.path.basename(path)} {key}={value}")
    return True


applied = 0
skipped_unset = 0
skipped_reject = 0
errored = 0
for entry in APPLY_MAP:
    env_name, path, section, key, quoted = entry
    raw = os.environ.get(env_name, "")
    if not raw:
        skipped_unset += 1
        continue
    try:
        if section is None:
            ok = apply_kvp(path, key, raw)
        else:
            ok = apply_keyed(path, section, key, raw, quoted)
        if ok:
            applied += 1
        else:
            skipped_reject += 1
    except Exception:
        errored += 1
        log(f"ERROR while applying {env_name} → {key}:")
        traceback.print_exc(file=sys.stdout)

log(f"pass complete: applied={applied} skipped(unset)={skipped_unset} skipped(rejected)={skipped_reject} errored={errored}")
PYEOF
APPLY_CONFIG_SH_EOF
chmod +x /mnt/server/scripts/apply-config.sh

echo "==> Extracting Funcom OCI images and patching binary loaders..."
echo "    This may take several minutes with no visible output."
cd /mnt/server
ln -snfr server depot
bash scripts/install.sh /mnt/server

# install.sh writes customstart.sh to $BASE/../customstart.sh which lands at
# /mnt/customstart.sh outside the server volume (an AMP-specific path that
# doesn't survive into the runtime container). The Dockerfile owns the
# equivalent setup (K8s ServiceAccount mount), so drop the leftover.
rm -f /mnt/customstart.sh

echo "==> Writing Pelican entrypoint wrapper..."
cat > /mnt/server/pelican-entrypoint.sh <<'PELICAN_ENTRYPOINT_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Pelican / Wings entrypoint for Dune: Awakening.
#
# This is THIS REPO's contribution — it replaces AMP's PreStartStages with
# a single foreground command that Pelican Wings can launch.
#
# Sequence matches upstream duneawakeningstart.json:
#   prestart → start-pg → migrate-db → start-mq-admin → start-mq-game
#   → start-text-router → start-mock-k8s → start-director → start-gateway
#   → console.sh (foreground, traps SIGTERM/SIGINT)
#
# UE5 instances are NOT started here — mock-k8s spawns them on demand
# from $STATE/ondemand.ini's AlwaysWarmMaps list.
#
# Prerequisites set up by the install script + Dockerfile:
#   - Funcom OCI depot extracted under /home/container/extracted/
#   - CubeCoders scripts at /home/container/scripts/
#   - /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ exists and is writable
#     by the `container` user (provisioned in the Dockerfile)

set -euo pipefail

BASE="${DUNE_BASE_DIR:-/home/container}"
export DUNE_BASE_DIR="$BASE"
cd "$BASE"

# Sanity: the runtime image must pre-create the K8s ServiceAccount mount.
# AMP does this via a root-run customstart.sh hook; we do it in the
# Dockerfile so the path already exists when the unprivileged container
# user takes over.
SA_DIR="/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount"
if [ ! -d "$SA_DIR" ] || [ ! -w "$SA_DIR" ]; then
    echo "[entrypoint] [ERROR] $SA_DIR missing or not writable." >&2
    echo "[entrypoint] [ERROR] Your runtime Docker image must pre-create this" >&2
    echo "[entrypoint] [ERROR] directory with container-user ownership (see docker/Dockerfile)." >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Generate a stable mock-k8s ServiceAccount bearer token on first boot.
# mock-k8s-go validates the token against the regex ServerId=([A-Za-z0-9_+/=\-]+)
# (baked into the binary as a holdover from CubeCoders' anti-tamper check).
# Any string matching that prefix works; the suffix only needs to be stable
# across restarts so the Director's cached identity stays valid.
mkdir -p "$BASE/server/state"
SA_TOKEN_FILE="$BASE/server/state/sa-token"
if [ ! -f "$SA_TOKEN_FILE" ]; then
    { printf 'ServerId='; head -c 32 /dev/urandom | base64 -w0; } > "$SA_TOKEN_FILE"
fi
export AMP_TOKEN="$(cat "$SA_TOKEN_FILE")"

echo "[entrypoint] [INFO] Dune Awakening — Pelican boot sequence starting"
echo "[entrypoint] [INFO]   BASE=$BASE"
echo "[entrypoint] [INFO]   World title: ${DUNE_WORLD_TITLE:-<unset>}"
echo "[entrypoint] [INFO]   Region:      ${DUNE_REGION:-<unset>}"
echo "[entrypoint] [INFO]   External IP: ${DUNE_EXTERNAL_IP:-<unset>}"

bash scripts/prestart.sh         "$BASE"

# Apply panel-driven overrides to Funcom's UE5 ini files after prestart
# seeds the templates. Every boot rewrites whatever the operator changed
# in the panel; empty/unset env vars are skipped so manual edits survive.
# Full mapping (env → file/section/key) lives in scripts/apply-config.sh.
bash scripts/apply-config.sh "$BASE"

bash scripts/start-pg.sh         "$BASE"
bash scripts/migrate-db.sh       "$BASE"
bash scripts/start-mq-admin.sh   "$BASE"
bash scripts/start-mq-game.sh    "$BASE"
bash scripts/start-text-router.sh "$BASE"
bash scripts/start-mock-k8s.sh   "$BASE"
bash scripts/start-director.sh   "$BASE"
bash scripts/start-gateway.sh    "$BASE"

exec bash scripts/console.sh "$BASE"
PELICAN_ENTRYPOINT_EOF
chmod +x /mnt/server/pelican-entrypoint.sh

echo "==> Install complete."
echo "    Runtime container will boot via:  bash /home/container/pelican-entrypoint.sh"

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Funcom dedicated-server depot to install. 4754530 = Production (retail); 3104830 = Public Test (PTC). Both are anonymous-accessible — no Steam login required.

variables.name: Release Version
variables.description: Must match Steam App ID. Used by prestart.sh to select retail vs beta FLS environment. Set to 4754530 for retail, 3104830 for PTC.

variables.name: Self-Host Service Token (DUNE_JWT)
variables.description: Funcom JWT from https://account.duneawakening.com/ (or account-pts.duneawakening.com for PTC). TREAT AS A SECRET. Each running battlegroup needs its own unique token.

variables.name: World Title
variables.description: Display name in the in-game server browser.

variables.name: Region
variables.description: Region label, e.g. 'Europe', 'North America', 'Europe Test'. Shown to players in the server browser.

variables.name: World Name Override
variables.description: Optional. Paste a previously FLS-registered WorldName to keep the same battlegroup identity after wiping state. Leave blank to auto-generate on first boot (and never change after).

variables.name: Datacenter ID
variables.description: Free-form label for FLS provider identification.

variables.name: Bind IP
variables.description: What internal services bind to inside the container. Almost always 0.0.0.0 (all interfaces). Wings sets this for you in most cases.

variables.name: External (Public) IP
variables.description: Your public WAN IP, advertised to clients via FLS. If the panel knows the node's public IP, set this manually to match. Required.

variables.name: Game Port Base (UDP)
variables.description: Base UDP port for the UE5 instance pool. Funcom uses 7777 by default; Wings allocates 7777-7806 (30 slots) for this server. SERVER_PORT is wired to this value.

variables.name: RabbitMQ Game Port (TCP/TLS)
variables.description: TLS AMQP endpoint advertised to clients via FLS. Funcom uses 5673.

variables.name: RabbitMQ Game Mgmt Port (TCP)
variables.description: HTTP management endpoint advertised to clients for token auth. Funcom uses 15673.

variables.name: Server Join Password
variables.description: Password players must enter to join any sietch in this battlegroup. Default 'Sandworm' comes from Funcom's template — change it to keep your server private. Special characters: avoid double quotes (they break the INI parser).

variables.name: Server Display Name
variables.description: Display name shown for every sietch in the battlegroup browser. Defaults to Funcom's template 'My Arrakis, My Dune'. Avoid double quotes.

variables.name: Mining Output Multiplier
variables.description: Hand-mined resource yield scalar. 1.0 = normal Funcom default. Higher = more ore per pickaxe swing. Maps to Dune.GlobalMiningOutputMultiplier.

variables.name: Vehicle Mining Output Multiplier
variables.description: Vehicle-mining resource yield scalar (sandcrawlers, etc.). 1.0 = normal. Maps to Dune.GlobalVehicleMiningOutputMultiplier.

variables.name: PvP Zone Resource Bonus
variables.description: Bonus multiplier applied to resource yields inside PvP-enabled zones. Funcom default 2.5. Maps to SecurityZones.PvpResourceMultiplier.

variables.name: Vehicle Durability Damage
variables.description: Damage scalar applied to vehicle durability. 0 disables vehicle damage entirely, 1.0 = normal, 10 = maximum. Maps to dw.VehicleDurabilityDamageMultiplier.

variables.name: Sandworm Invuln (Vehicle Exit, seconds)
variables.description: Window in seconds during which a player is safe from sandworms after exiting a vehicle. Funcom default 900 (15 min). Maps to Vehicle.SandwormInvulnerabilitySecondsOnExit.

variables.name: Sandworm Invuln (Server Restart, seconds)
variables.description: Window in seconds during which players are safe from sandworms after the server restarts. Funcom default 7200 (2 h). Maps to Vehicle.SandwormInvulnerabilitySecondsOnServerRestart.

variables.name: Sandworm Can Damage Vehicles
variables.description: If True, sandworms can push and damage vehicles on contact. Funcom default False. Maps to Vehicle.SandwormCollisionInteraction.

variables.name: Sandstorms Enabled
variables.description: Enable scheduled sandstorm weather events. Funcom default True. Maps to Sandstorm.Enabled.

variables.name: Sandstorm Treasure Drops
variables.description: Enable bonus loot drops during sandstorms. Funcom default True. Maps to Sandstorm.Treasure.Enabled.

variables.name: Sandworms Enabled
variables.description: Enable sandworm spawns globally. Funcom default True. Maps to sandworm.dune.Enabled.

variables.name: Sandworm Danger Zones Visible
variables.description: Show on-map danger-zone overlays where sandworms can attack. Funcom default True. Maps to Sandworm.SandwormDangerZonesEnabled.

variables.name: Force PvP On All Partitions
variables.description: If True, every map allows PvP regardless of its partition's PvP/PvE setting. Funcom default False. Maps to /Script/DuneSandbox.PvpPveSettings.m_bShouldForceEnablePvpOnAllPartitions.

variables.name: Security Zones (Safe Zones) Enabled
variables.description: If False, PvP and abilities are permitted everywhere with no safe-zone protection. Funcom default True. Maps to /Script/DuneSandbox.SecurityZonesSubsystem.m_bAreSecurityZonesEnabled.

variables.name: Coriolis Storm Auto-Spawn
variables.description: Allow Coriolis storms to spawn automatically. Funcom default True. Maps to /Script/DuneSandbox.SandStormConfig.m_bCoriolisAutoSpawnEnabled.

variables.name: Item Deterioration Rate (seconds)
variables.description: Item deterioration tick interval in seconds. 0 disables item decay entirely, 1.0 = normal (Funcom default), 10 = fastest. Maps to /DeteriorationSystem.ItemDeteriorationConstants.UpdateRateInSeconds.

variables.name: Max Landclaim Segments Per Player
variables.description: Maximum number of land-claim flags one player may own at the same time. Funcom default 6. Maps to /Script/DuneSandbox.BuildingSettings.m_MaxNumLandclaimSegments.

variables.name: Building Blueprint Max Extensions
variables.description: How many times a blueprinted building can be extended past its base footprint. Funcom default 4. Maps to /Script/DuneSandbox.BuildingSettings.m_BuildingBlueprintMaxExtensions.

variables.name: Base Backup Max Extensions
variables.description: How many times a base backup can be extended. Funcom default 8. Maps to /Script/DuneSandbox.BuildingSettings.m_BaseBackupMaxExtensions.

variables.name: Building Restriction Limits Enforced
variables.description: Enforce server-side limits on where players may build (dungeons, POIs, etc.). Funcom default True. Maps to /Script/DuneSandbox.BuildingSettings.m_bBuildingRestrictionLimitsEnabled.

variables.name: Max Concurrent UE5 Instances
variables.description: Hard cap on UE5 server instances mock-k8s will run at once. Must be at least the always-warm map count or maps fail to come up. Pelican default 8.

variables.name: On-Demand Idle Timeout (Go duration)
variables.description: How long an empty on-demand UE5 instance stays warm before mock-k8s despawns it. Go-style duration (e.g. 30s, 10m, 1h). Pelican default 10m.

variables.name: Always-Warm Maps
variables.description: Comma-separated maps kept running at all times (don't scale on demand). Each kept-warm map consumes a slot from Max Concurrent Instances. Default Survival_1,Overmap,DeepDesert_1.
